items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Oscar come out and played with us one night

ctx.x: When Duke saw Oscar standing there Duke called 'Jack the Bear' and all the things there that had solos in them and, my God, -- Oscar knew every introduction. You know, he was with the band for about three or four years. So, let me tell you, Duke lit into 'Jack the Bear' and he said, 'Clang, clang.' And Oscar said, 'Do-do-do-do do-do do-do do-do.'
